Pairs 1-4 viewed at full size; 5-7 viewed in a montage and read as the same photo, slightly less certain. Reproduce: gray 72x72 images, crop 80% of one side (or 60%), resize to 32x32, mean-centred correlation over 4 rotations x flip; view the top 30 by score. Found in the top 14 of the edge ranking and the top 30 of the crop ranking only; 51 extras score above 0.8 on the crop ranking and I did not view the rest, so the count is a floor.

Why the build misses them: the 0.75 check uses a full-frame 32x32 correlation, so a crop or zoom of the same photo falls below 0.75 (these score 0.84-0.86 on the crop-tolerant measure but are not caught). The new regression test only runs the same measure, so it cannot see this class.
notes: Rate: at least 7 of 4,351 extras (0.16%), probably somewhat more. Impact on E12 is small in absolute terms (at most a few of the roughly 2,000 dev/test photos have a training copy, in disease classes with 30-60 dev photos each, so a visible effect on one class is possible but on macro-F1 it would be a fraction of a point), but the copies are easy ones and the plan says no copy reaches training, so I fail it rather than waive it. A fix is cheap: add the crop-tolerant correlation (80% and 60% crops, threshold near 0.8) as a second drop step and view the 51 or so pairs it flags, then extend the regression test to a cropped fixture.
